plain: Capping how confident an AI judge's label is allowed to be, so no single overconfident vote pushes training too hard.
eli5: Letting a very sure friend vote, but only counting the vote as a little more than half sure.
technical: In Bai et al. (2022), chain-of-thought feedback labels came out near 0 or 1, so each label's probability was clamped into 40–60% (20–80% was also tried) before training the preference model; without it, RL-CAI learned more extreme responses.
